description: This file contains unit tests for the RootCanvas component, focusing on the logic determining whether quick setup should be presented based on various conditions.

classes.name: RootCanvasPresentationTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing multiple test cases related to the RootCanvas's quick setup presentation logic.

methods.name: quickSetupDoesNotPresentWhenGatewayAlreadyConfigured
methods.description: Test that quick setup does not present when a gateway is already configured, even if other conditions suggest it might.

methods.name: quickSetupPresentsForFreshInstallWithDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Test that quick setup appears during a fresh install when a gateway has been discovered.

methods.name: quickSetupDoesNotPresentWhenAlreadyConnected
methods.description: Test that quick setup does not present if the gateway is already connected, regardless of other conditions.
